description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamam and Paper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade based on the cost of living index. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance. This content pertains to public sector service conditions and benefits for workers, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
